title: Phase 3 Study of Investigator Choice of Chemotherapy with or without Zoldonrasib as First-line Treatment in Metastatic KRAS G12D-mutated Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study of Investigator Choice of Chemotherapy (modified FOLFIRINOX or Gemcitabine plus Nab-paclitaxel) with or without Zoldonrasib (RMC-9805) as First-line Treatment in Patients with Metastatic KRAS G12D-mutated Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (RASolute 305)
summary: Main objective: To compare the efficacy of zoldonrasib plus Investigator choice of chemotherapy (mFFX or GnP) versus placebo plus Investigator choice of chemotherapy (mFFX or GnP)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patients (≥18 years or legal age of consent)
2. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
3. Histologically of cytologically confirmed pancreatic adenocarcinoma
4. Metastatic disease, newly diagnosed within ≤6 weeks prior to screening
5. Documented KRAS G12D mutations identified by a validated assay
6. At least one measurable lesion per RECIST version 1.1
7. Adequate organ function (hematologic, hepatic and renal)
8. Able to take oral medications
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior systemic therapy for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma
2. Prior treatment with RAS-targeted therapies (including KRAS inhibitors) or MAPK pathway targeted agents
3. Presence of other known actionable oncogenic driver alterations for which approved targeted therapies are available (eg BRAF V600E, MSI-high/dMMR, NTRK fusions)
4. Non-adenocarcinoma pancreatic malignancies (eg neuroendocrine tumors, acinar cell carcinoma)
5. Untreated or symptomatic central nervous system metastases or leptomeningeal disease
6. Clinically significant uncontrolled comorbidities (including cardiovascular, pulmonary, or gastrointestinal conditions that may affect safety or drug absorption)
7. Active uncontrolled infections, including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV not meeting protocol-defined control criteria
8. Major surgery within 28 days prior to randomization
9. Noncompliance with study visits or procedures
